name: Slithering Looters
summary: Saria Fairmoon seeks the Staff of Archmage Selwyn among Eldarath’s relics. Naga are looting the ruins, and she asks you to recover it.

sections.title: Saria’s Search
sections.body: Saria Fairmoon has come to Azshara to study highborne artifacts. She says naga are looting the ruins of Eldarath to the west, led by Lady Sesspira. Saria suspects Sesspira has the staff of Archmage Selwyn, a fallen highborne mage. She asks you to bring it to her, since she is ill-suited for combat.

sections.title: The Staff
sections.body: Saria receives the staff in pristine condition. She finds your partnership of scholarly mind and willing strength agreeable, and asks whether you would help her again.

faq.q: Who is asking for the staff?
faq.answer: Saria Fairmoon is studying highborne artifacts in Azshara and asks you to bring her the Staff of Archmage Selwyn.
Saria believes Lady Sesspira may have the Staff of Archmage Selwyn among the relics in the Ruins of Eldarath.
Lady Sesspira is a naga who leads the looting of the Ruins of Eldarath.
Archmage Selwyn was a highborne mage who has fallen.
Saria says scholars like her are ill-suited for combat, so she asks you to retrieve the staff.
